_readme: Edit this file while the scanner runs; it reloads itself within ~5 seconds. Bad entries are skipped with a warning.
Check your edits with:  python3 scanner.py --check-game   (also lists every metric and bounty match key you can use).
Every quest/bounty/achievement/title needs a unique lowercase 'id' (a-z 0-9 _ -). Progress is saved by id, so renaming an id resets it.
Quests count TODAY only; achievements and title metrics count LIFETIME. Bounties watch for devices that match their 'match' rule.
Bounty match keys (all must match): category, tier (alert/possible/known/none), addr_type, vendor/name/label (regex), uuid, mfg (company id), min_rssi, followed.
Title unlock types: always, level, achievement, bounty, quest, metric.
INTEL COINS: earned by quests, bounties, achievements, level-ups, streaks, tactical finds, hunts and scan time; spent in the Coin Exchange (key e).

coin_rules / coin_caps set what each event pays and its daily cap (null removes a cap). Quests, bounties and achievements may add their own "coins": N; otherwise they pay from XP (settings.quest_xp_per_coin etc.) or bounty_<difficulty>.

shop: an entry with a known id edits that item (name, description, price, min_level, hidden, enabled:false). A new id adds a theme (spec: mode mono/duo/cycle + #rrggbb colors) or glitch (spec: kinds tear/split/corrupt/flash, level 1-3).

DAILY HOOKS: the "retention" block controls Daily Surge (bonus XP in your first minutes of scanning each day), Streak Shields, the streak coin ladder, Daily Caches (loot boxes for finishing quests), Weekly Ops + Weekly Chest and the Welcome Back bonus.

Weekly ops use counter metrics only (devices_seen, scan_minutes, active_days, quests_completed ...): progress is how much the counter grows during the week. Check edits with python3 scanner.py --check-game.
